subject_session: Buddy, Gatsby, Cicero, Achilles (one session each, MAZE epoch)

headline_stat.name: median circular-linear correlation |rho| across 135 place fields

stated_limitation: Analysis used one representative session per rat, streamed directly from the DANDI S3 bucket with `remfile` (only the MAZE-epoch slice of one LFP channel, the spike tables, and the position tables were fetched, not the full 5-9 GB files).

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki dorsal CA1, rats on a linear track) is the canonical dataset for theta phase precession.
justification.handling: Real data streamed in slices, MAZE epoch isolated, excitatory units and minimum-spike filters applied, and an undocumented position-rate/period quirk was detected and corrected with a validating lap figure.
justification.analysis: Standard Kempter circular-linear regression plus circular-linear correlation with a required position-label permutation null, all appropriate circular statistics done correctly.
justification.correctness: Values are internally consistent and reproduce from the figures, but the significant-field count differs between README (92/135) and Figure 3 (93), a minor off-by-one inconsistency.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show the effect with labeled axes, units, sample sizes, and example units selected by correlation strength (the effect being demonstrated), not by fitted slope.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and calibrated (reports 76% negative-slope, 68% significant rather than overclaiming), with nothing misrepresented, but no specific limitations of this result are named.
